Every good dog has a person walking beside it. We started Two Shadows for that pair: the walks, the sofa, the habits you build together over years.

Our chews are made in the UK and kept simple, so looking after your dog’s gut is one more small thing you do together.

settings.question: What are Gut & Digestion chews?
settings.answer: Soft chews for dogs made with Bacillus velezensis, a live gut-flora culture, plus prebiotic inulin and natural fibres. They’re a complementary feed designed to support healthy digestion.

settings.question: What is Bacillus velezensis?
settings.answer: A naturally occurring, spore-forming bacterium. The strain we use, DSM 15544, is listed as zootechnical additive 4b1820, a gut flora stabiliser: it helps keep the good bacteria in your dog’s gut in balance.

settings.question: Does it contain probiotics?
settings.answer: Yes. Bacillus velezensis DSM 15544 is listed as a zootechnical additive at 7.50 × 10¹¹ CFU per kg.

settings.question: Why a soft chew?
settings.answer: Most dogs take it like a treat, so there’s no powder to mix and no tablet to hide in food. That makes the daily routine easier to keep up.

settings.question: How many should I give?
settings.answer: It depends on weight: under 10 kg, one chew a day; 10–30 kg, two; 30–45 kg, three; over 45 kg, four. The guide is on every jar. Not sure? Email us your dog’s weight.

settings.question: Is it right for my dog?
settings.answer: Gut & Digestion is for dogs over 12 weeks old. If your dog is unwell, on medication or has a health condition, have a word with your vet first.
